episodes.title: Nerd Today, Boss Tomorrow
episodes.summary: When his girlfriend breaks up with him after spending the year abroad, Moritz schemes to win her back by snagging a stash of ecstasy.

episodes.title: Life's Not Fair, Get Used to It
episodes.summary: Lisa lands in trouble with her parents. Moritz reprograms MyTems into an online drug store and tries to make amends to Lenny.

episodes.title: Failure is Not an Option
episodes.summary: Business is booming, and Buba wants a piece of the action -- but the product is getting bad reviews. Lisa thinks Dan has been ignoring her.

episodes.title: If This is Reality, I'm Not Interested
episodes.summary: Moritz's reputation takes a hit. After discovering a troubling email, Lenny confides in a new friend. Jens enlists Moritz to crack a password.

episodes.title: Score Big or Don't Score at All
episodes.summary: Lenny sets up the clear web shop while Moritz secretly meets a new supplier in Rotterdam. But the friends don't see eye to eye about their future.

episodes.title: If You Are the Smartest One in the Room, You're in the Wrong Room
episodes.summary: Things begin to unravel the day after the party, and Moritz is forced to turn to his rival for help. Lisa has a change of heart.

episodes.title: Think Different
episodes.summary: After making a million euros, the guys decide they want out of MyDrugs, so a nervous Moritz goes to Rotterdam to break the news to their suppliers.

episodes.title: Where Do You Want to Go Today?
episodes.summary: Moritz wrestles with the secrets he's been keeping from Lisa. Dan thinks fast under pressure, and Lenny and Kira get closer.

episodes.title: Inspired by Real Life
episodes.summary: Inspired by the results of a career test, Moritz embraces his role as CEO — but loses his cool when Lenny suggests Kira join the team.

episodes.title: Buy It. Sell It. Love It.
episodes.summary: Following a dangerous standoff, the guys search for a way to convert their bitcoins into cash, and Moritz's many lies start to catch up with him.

episodes.title: Move Fast and Break Things
episodes.summary: Moritz confides in Lisa, who warns him to clean up his act. Later, a tempting offer from Goodtimes tests his loyalty to Lenny and Dan.

episodes.title: Don't be evil.
episodes.summary: The guys' rivalry heats up. At a party in Rotterdam, Moritz gets a rude awakening and tries to warn his friends.

episodes.title: A single failure, a little slip
episodes.summary: Under pressure from Goodtimes, Moritz races to rebuild MyDrugs during a school trip to the woods, but code bugs — and allergies — derail his progress.

episodes.title: A misdemeanor, a little trip
episodes.summary: Lenny helps Moritz with the site on one condition: that they keep their collaboration a secret. Meanwhile, Jens frets about his son's future.

episodes.title: Does this condemn me, lock me away?
episodes.summary: Moritz hires a high-priced business consultant. Kira and Dan come up with new ways to raise money for Lenny's medical treatment.

episodes.title: Before you turn the key, I have one more thing to say
episodes.summary: The guys take a road trip to Rotterdam. Marie asks Lisa to keep an eye on her brother. When Moritz crosses a line, Dan does damage control.

episodes.title: To make amends, maybe be friends
episodes.summary: To celebrate the end of their Abitur exams, the students throw a costume party at school — and things get a little out of control.

episodes.title: Everybody gets a second chance
episodes.summary: A high-stakes situation leaves the friends scrambling to figure out their next move.

episodes.title: That Can't Happen.
episodes.summary: After four years behind bars, Moritz is excited to start a legitimate business venture — until he learns that Lenny and Dan beat him to it.

episodes.title: That Doesn't Happen on My Machine.
episodes.summary: Lenny hopes to reconnect with Moritz, who has other things on his mind. Lisa looks into a recent string of murders with a peculiar connection.

episodes.title: That Shouldn't Happen!
episodes.summary: Moritz has a plan for BonusLife, but he'll need to raise money first. Ersan suggests a meeting with his boss, who immediately puts them on the spot.

episodes.title: Why Does That Happen?
episodes.summary: Lisa's investigation hits a nerve. Given a week to achieve the impossible, Moritz sees only one option: a company hackathon.

episodes.title: Oh, I See.
episodes.summary: Fearful of having endangered Lisa, Moritz resorts to drastic measures. Lenny learns the truth about Dan's mismanagement of BonusLife.

episodes.title: How Did That Ever Work?
episodes.summary: Trapped in the desert with a gun to his head, Moritz must think fast to save his life — and those of his friends.
